criteria.title: Manual requirement 1
criteria.source: Pricing page content must list Free at $0/mo, Pro at $9/mo, and Enterprise at $49/mo.

reference.rationale: pricing.html contains three plan headings and their displayed text prices. This is source copy, not billing execution.

criteria.title: Manual requirement 2
criteria.source: Home page content must state: We care about privacy, and will never share your data.

reference.rationale: The exact sentence occurs in the newsletter section of index.html. It proves the promised copy only, not privacy practices.

criteria.title: Manual requirement 3
criteria.source: Contact form source content must label Full name, Email address, Phone number, and Message.

reference.rationale: contact.html contains all four labels explicitly associated with input/textarea IDs. This requirement asks only for source content, not submission or rendered accessibility.

criteria.title: Manual requirement 4
criteria.source: Contact page source copy must include the exact notice: Form submission successful!

reference.rationale: The exact notice is present in contact.html in a d-none message container. The requirement is only source-copy presence; it does not assert that the notice is currently visible or conditional at runtime.

criteria.title: Manual requirement 5
criteria.source: FAQ page content must include the exact question: Can I cancel my plan within 30 days?

reference.rationale: The full FAQ HTML has generic Accordion Item questions and no requested cancellation question. This task explicitly requires the literal question, not inferred policy semantics.

criteria.title: Original requirement 1
criteria.source: FAQ page contact details must include support@domain.com.

reference.rationale: faq.html has a mailto:support@domain.com link with that exact text. It is a template placeholder, not verified mailbox delivery.

criteria.title: Original requirement 2
criteria.source: The contact form must send a real email only after valid submission and show success after delivery.

reference.rationale: No runtime, activation token, email service response, or independent inbox observation supplied; static success/error containers cannot establish email behavior.

criteria.title: Original requirement 3
criteria.source: Choosing Pro must actually charge $9 per month and retain a queryable subscription record.

reference.rationale: Pricing copy and choose-plan links are not payment execution or durable subscription records; source review cannot prove those operations.

criteria.title: Manual requirement 1
criteria.source: Dashboard page source copy must include the exact table headings Payment Mode and Payment Status.

reference.rationale: index.html contains both th texts verbatim. These are literal column headings and no real payment action is required by this criterion.

criteria.title: Manual requirement 2
criteria.source: Dashboard page content must show Transfer to Paypal with the amount $236 in Transaction History.

reference.rationale: The first transaction-history source card contains Transfer to Paypal and $236. These are public demonstration records in an open-source template, not authenticated transactions.

criteria.title: Manual requirement 3
criteria.source: Login page source content must include the labels Username or email * and Password *.

reference.rationale: pages/samples/login.html contains both labels as literal label elements. This criterion asks for source text only, not authentication behavior.

criteria.title: Manual requirement 4
criteria.source: 404 page content must say The page you’re looking for was not found. and Back to home.

reference.rationale: pages/samples/error-404.html contains the exact sentence and home-link text; source text does not prove serving the right HTTP status.

criteria.title: Manual requirement 5
criteria.source: Register page body copy must contain the exact sentence We never sell your personal information.

reference.rationale: The full register.html source does not include this newly required sentence; no external dependency is assumed to supply required body copy.

criteria.title: Original requirement 1
criteria.source: Login must authenticate correct credentials and reject incorrect passwords while keeping different users isolated.

reference.rationale: Static public template HTML cannot establish server-side authentication, password checks, sessions, or per-user authorization.

criteria.title: Original requirement 2
criteria.source: Transfer to Paypal must actually execute a $236 payment and verify its provider transaction status.

reference.rationale: The dashboard is only static source copy and sample amounts. No real payment/provider evidence is supplied, and no money-moving operation is attempted in this evaluation.

criteria.title: Original requirement 3
criteria.source: Registration must persist a new account and keep that account queryable after a server restart.

reference.rationale: No account service, persistence, server execution or independent readback supplied; register markup is insufficient.
